title: Comparative Bioavailability Study of Codeine Sulfate
brief_summary: The objective of this study was to assess the comparative bioavailability of codeine from Roxane Laboratories' Codeine Sulfate 30mg tablets to Tylenol® #3 (acetaminophen 300mg with codeine phosphate 30mg) under fasted conditions
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* No clinically significant abnormal findings on the physical examination, medical history, or clinical laboratory results during screening.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Positive test for HIV, Hepatitis B, or Hepatitis C.
* Treatment with known enzyme altering drugs.
* History of allergic or adverse response to codeine sulfate or any comparable or similar product.
